inputs.issue: I want to update the side panel. Files currently shows useful contents, but both chat and tasks can be improved. Tasks should show a list item per top level workflow that you can click on to show the task view contents of that workflow. For chat, there should be a list of runs ordered by completion date descending (uncompleted first, oldest last). Every list should have a sort + group by. The task list groups by the workflow definition. The chat list groups by nothing (but optionally can be status). The task lists group by is fixed, but the chat list can be changed. The sort should be sort by last message / last event timestamp newest first. the group by categories should mirror the badge/pill system. also, when grouped by workflow, those pills should be used to show the tasks in each state. Its all about being able to have a lot of work in flight and being able to manage it all easily. When you group by workflow definition, you should be able to see the workflow instances states in the pills. This enables you to quickly understand the state of instances in a workflow. when you sort by the last message/event date you naturally get uncompleted work earlier. If you group by status, then the order of states is something like: waiting, in progress, failed, completed
